title: Detecting Word-Substitution Poisoning of a RAG Knowledge Base with Relative Entropy and Runtime Verification
abstract: arXiv:2611.27410v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) system answers questions using passages it retrieves from a knowledge base, so users must trust that knowledge base. We study an attacker who quietly edits existing passages by swapping words for synonyms (PWWS, TextFooler) in a cybersecurity RAG system built from MITRE ATT&CK and CAPEC. Using a reviewed 44-question benchmark, repeated paired runs and a control corpus in which only the layout changes, we find that poisoning lowers judged answer correctness from 0.714 to 0.555. The damage comes mostly from lost evidence and refusals, not from false statements. To find the edited passages, we use relative entropy. Comparing a whole passage with normal text is a weak signal. Still, one term of the relative entropy, the log-ratio between a word and its most probable synonym, works well: with a small language model as the reference, it reaches an AUROC of 0.95 and stays near chance on the control. translated_title: 基于相对熵与运行时验证检测RAG知识库中的词替换投毒攻击
translated_abstract: 检索增强生成（RAG）系统利用从知识库中检索到的文段来回答问题，因此用户必须信任该知识库。我们研究了一种攻击者，其通过将单词替换为同义词（PWWS、TextFooler）来悄悄篡改现有文段，攻击对象是一个基于MITRE ATT&CK和CAPEC构建的网络安全RAG系统。借助一个经过审核的44题基准测试、多次重复的成对实验以及一个仅改变排版格式的对照语料库，我们发现投毒会使评判的答案正确率从0.714降至0.555。损害主要来自证据丢失和拒答，而非虚假陈述。为了找出被篡改的文段，我们使用相对熵：将整个文段与正常文本进行比较只能提供微弱信号，但相对熵中的一项——即一个词与其最可能同义词之间的对数比——效果很好：以小型语言模型作为参考时，该方法达到0.95的AUROC，而在对照语料库上则接近随机水平。
tldr: 该论文发现针对RAG知识库的同义词替换投毒主要通过证据丢失和拒答降低答案质量而非制造虚假陈述，并提出利用相对熵中的词-同义词对数比项结合小型语言模型作为参考来高效检测被投毒文段，AUROC达到0.95。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that word-substitution poisoning of a RAG knowledge base degrades answer quality mainly through lost evidence and refusals rather than false statements, and proposes detecting poisoned passages using the log-ratio term of relative entropy with a small language model as reference, achieving an AUROC of 0.95.
